translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

book.name: 2 Koriyn
book.title: 2 KORIYN Pol Minj Kisen Koriyn Biynimb Kuyip Tikak

content: Kun ak Gor yip jimñiy woŋg gipun rek, nimbip minim kilis giy aŋgiy aspun: Gor nimbip simb niŋiy, Krays nup yokek apiy dak ak mey, nup ma kirginimimb aspun.

content.text: “Minim kun ak rek niŋnim aŋgiy mindenik ñin ak, yip aŋgniŋenak niŋnik. Nip dinim aŋgiy mindenik ñin ak mey, nip dinik aŋgak.”

content: Kun aŋgak ak niŋbun; miñiy ñin biy Gor chinup simb niŋiy diniŋgamb. Miñiy ñin biy nup chiŋgiy mey, kim amniŋgambun.
Nup woŋg giñimbun ak amrep ginimuŋ aŋgiy, niŋrep giyiŋg gipun. Biynimb gunap niŋiy gos gunap apek, apyap pikniŋgambay ar ak ma gipun.
Pen yerer gipun ak, Gor nup woŋg gispun ak niŋniŋgiy aŋgiy, miñ tep ar ak nep gipun. Kun ak woŋg nup ak ma kirpun. Miker diy, kosyam mindiy akaŋ, yerer gek; gos kun ak ma niŋbun.
Chinup ñin gunap tapin pikpay; ñin gunap kalambis aypay; ñin gunap kinrep ma gipun; ñin gunap yiwan kinbun.
Pen mindrep giy; niŋrep giy; miluk ma niŋiy; biynimb direp giy; Gor kawnan yip mindiy; biynimb wasemb yimb ay,
minim niŋind yimb nep aŋgiy, Gor kilis ñakniŋ woŋg gipun rek; woŋg nup gipun ak niŋniŋg niŋniŋgambay. Chin Gor bi suŋ-tep nuk ak mey, chim kandiŋ tap gok ñin pis pis ñakniŋ, Seytan yip penpen gipun.
Biynimb gunap yimb chinup dand aranimbay; gunap dand apyowpay. Gunap chinup minim tep apay; gunap minim timey apay. Chinup bi yesek aŋgep aŋgiy niŋbay ak pen, chin bi minim niŋind nep apun.
Chinup ma niŋbun apay ak pen; niŋrep gipay. Kumbun rek ayip ak pen; kim mindpun. Tapin pikpay ak pen; ma kumbun.

Miker yomb gip ak pen; tep gakniŋ mindpun. Simbgeprek mindpun ak pen; chin gipun rek, biynimb kuŋaynep mindrep gipay. Tap ma mindip gok mindpun ak pen; Gor chinup kond mindakniŋ, mindrep giyiŋg gon amjap.
Koriyn biynimb. Nimbip mindmaŋgiy aypun rek, minim gunap weygiy ma aspun, miseŋ yimb aspun.
Nimbip mindmaŋgiy aynuk ak, kun giy nep mindip ak pen; chinup mindmaŋgiy ayiŋgipim miñ ak dam akay yokpim.
Chinup ma kirginimimb; nimbip gipun rek, chinup mindmaŋgiy aynimimb. Nimbip niŋen ñapan yand rek ayek kun aspiyn.
Biynimb Gor Ker Ma Mindpay Gok Yip Ma Yiŋgoŋg Ginimimb

Biynimb Gor nup gosimb niŋbay gok, biynimb yikop gok yip minim aŋg ar nokom ay, gey amnimuŋ rek ma ayip. Biynimb mind tep gipay gok, yergiy biynimb mindrep ma gipay gok yip, jimñiy gey amek tep giniŋgamb? Pen biynimb melik pis okok mindpay gok, yergiy biynimb kisyim pis okok mindpay gok yip, jimñiy mindeniŋgambay.

Krays yip, Seytan yip minim aŋg ar nokom ma ayniŋgayr. Biynimb Gor ker mindpay gok yip, biynimb yikop gok yip, gos ar nokom ma niŋniŋgambay. Chin biynimb nup ker mindpun gok, korip mindep nuk ak mindpun. Pen chin Gor korip mindpun gok sek, tap yikop aŋgniŋbay korip mindpay gok sek minim bap aŋg ar nokom ay, gon amnimuŋ rek ma ayip. Gor nuk key aŋgak,

content.text: “Yand namb kuyip okok mindiy, Biyomb kiyk ak minden, kiyk pen biynimb yand mindeniŋgambay aŋgak.”

content: Kun ak nuk aŋgip, “Kuyip kirgiy keynep mindiy, mindrep ginimimb. Tap asiŋ gok ma wilikem, nimbip diniŋgayn.
Den mey, Nap nimbik yand minden; nimb ñi pañ yand gok mindeniŋgambim aŋgip.” Biyomb gin yimb ak kun aŋgip.
